description: Welcome to ExpReview211! I’m a physics and CS enthusiast (who built a Python planetary orbit simulator) and a teen space podcast co-host passionate about turning real orbital mechanics into fun gameplay. For the Space Mission Design Game, we’re building an interactive mission-planning game using real NASA constraints—like delta-v budgets, launch windows, and payload trade-offs. Looking for creative coders, UI/graphic designers, and space storytellers. Everyone’s ideas matter here—let’s build!
